question: Which Housewife just walked away with the mansion AND the Rolls-Royce?
story: Porsha Williams just walked out of her divorce with the mansion, a Rolls-Royce, and a check for over one and a half million dollars. According to court documents obtained by TMZ, the Real Housewives of Atlanta star finalized her settlement with businessman Simon Guobadia this week. He reportedly signed over his entire ownership interest in their Atlanta home through a quitclaim deed. On top of that, she is owed one million five hundred sixty eight thousand dollars from his share of the equity, plus the title to a twenty twenty one Rolls-Royce Ghost. Here is the part that stings. She can now refinance or sell that house whenever she wants, with no input from him at all. Both of them confirmed the terms under oath at a hearing on August fifth, telling the judge every remaining issue was settled. They married in November twenty twenty two. She filed fifteen months later. She left with the keys to everything.
